turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, it's been a long day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm sixty-eight and I've decided to go camping alone for the first time. My kids think I've lost it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good for you. Would you feel more at ease at a campground with a host on site, or are you after somewhere truly remote?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a moment, like fifteen seconds. Ask me again then.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Any answer yet? Someone nearby, or properly off on your own?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A host, I think. Just this first time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sensible. You'll still have your own quiet site, with help close by if you need it.
